# stb_easy_font

`stb_easy_font.h` v0.5 comes from https://github.com/nothings/stb.
It generates small ASCII labels for native in-game keyboard and shoulder
button quads. No external font or image assets are required.

Copyright (c) 2017 Sean Barrett. Used under the MIT option in `LICENSE.txt`;
